WhatsApp form URL generated without sending

visual_comparisons.observations: Inspected equal-viewport original/replica screenshots. Layout, original content, typography, images and footer match on reviewed templates. Autoplay carousel/Swiper phase differs between independent frames; slide changes verified separately. This is manual sampled visual review, not an all-pixel claim across 63 routes.

limits: Screenshots do not independently measure every animation frame, hover state or every scroll position. Original JS, CSS and AOS parameters are preserved and verified.
Two upstream archive pages returned database errors and were reconstructed from original archive cards and captured taxonomy/post data.
Original missing overlay.png and broken /about/ destination retained.
No WhatsApp message, phone call, live deployment or main branch change performed.

Review iframe screenshots show a narrow scrollbar/gutter difference that can shift wrapping or vertical positions slightly. Production source/CSS remain unchanged; no claim of pixel identity is made for the HTMLPreview transport.
